scope: Palo Alto / Stanford - downtown University Ave, California Ave and the Welch Rd corridor
method: Each candidate was screened against data/lunch_specials.json and data/lunch_rejected.json by name+city and by street address before any page was opened (scripts/screen.py). Only businesses whose address, per-day hours and phone were readable in a 2025-2026 capture were written up; a price is printed only where a capture printed one. Yelp returns HTTP 403 to a direct fetch from this environment, so every Yelp figure below is read from a dated search-engine capture of the business page and the capture URL is cited.
